items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: he tested us, handed scores out to everybody and he explained to us, he said, "This is my latest composition, and just take it easy," and he started the orchestra and we played it for him.

ctx.x: So we -- yes, I said she was taking Paris by storm, she had the hall, the society's hall, the Ambassador's crowd, and Ciro's and everything else. All of the who's who, who comes from the world over, from the United States, from South America, I mean everybody came to Bricktop's. She was well-known. And Mr. Cole Porter made his headquarters at Chez Bricktop's.
